parent_evidence: U5.R2U0 finds ColorFM hierarchical colour coupling to be a distinct explicit transport prior but not identified pairing
U5.R2O0 supplies a validated bounded cube-preserving explicit colour representation
U5.R2S3 and U5.R2S4 separate distribution matching, condition correspondence and hidden-operator recovery
hypothesis: within several correctly corresponding synthetic content conditions, hierarchical mean-centred RGB-octant coupling may provide pseudo-pairs that recover a hidden bounded colour flow more accurately and stably than random, pooled or shuffled-condition coupling
epistemic_scope: small synthetic development of one coupling prior; constructed pairs are never observed truth and a pass cannot identify any real unpaired operator

coupling.partition: recursively subtract each domain subset mean and match RGB sign octants
coupling.leaf_pairing: fixed-seed random pairing without replacement up to the smaller leaf size
coupling.fallback: fixed-seed random pairing when no corresponding non-empty leaves survive

methods.description: random source/target pairing independently inside each correct generated condition
discard condition ids and apply HCC to the pooled source and target samples
apply HCC separately inside each correctly corresponding generated condition and fit one shared flow
apply HCC after the fixed non-identity target-condition permutation

optimization.objective: mean squared RGB error on constructed pairs only

evaluation.operator_truth: hidden analytic style flow used only after fitting
evaluation.heldout_distribution_loss: fixed RFF-MMD-192 evaluated on correct heldout conditions
evaluation.same_style_replicate: independent observations and independent frozen pair seeds
evaluation.pairs_exposed_to_optimizer: constructed HCC/random pairs only; no real or oracle pairs

allowed_actions: implement the published HCC pseudocode clean-room in a reusable isolated module
fit only the validated bounded U5.R2O0 flow from constructed synthetic pairs
use local RTX 5070 Ti Laptop deterministic float32 optimization
run focused partition, permutation, no-reuse, bound and repeat tests
run two complete development reports after activation
forbidden_actions: execute before a repeated eligible U5.R2S4 decision
expose oracle pairs, grids or coefficients to fitting
call HCC pairs observed correspondence or identified transport
infer conditions from RGB, CLIP, content, source, uploader or scanner
change depth, permutation, seeds, optimization or gates after results
train ColorFM-L, a semantic encoder or direct final-RGB model
use project photographs or film pixels

branches.primary_all_gates_pass: retain HCC as a synthetic coupling baseline and require a separate real-data condition/rights DoR before any pixel experiment
branches.operator_fails_despite_pair_fit: close as plausible coupling without hidden-operator recovery
branches.primary_does_not_beat_controls: close without depth, model or optimizer rescue
branches.shuffled_negative_passes: close because condition identity is not discriminating
branches.structure_or_repeat_fails: invalidate and debug only representation or deterministic execution

claim_ceiling: synthetic development evidence for or against one published hierarchical colour-coupling prior when fitting a known bounded explicit flow; never observed pairing, real-image, film, stock, calibrated or general unpaired-operator identification
